content: Official provider documentation confirms that selecting hosted APIs transmits meeting-derived content off-device and that retention varies by provider, endpoint, account controls, and routing. OpenAI documents default abuse-monitoring retention for many endpoints; Groq documents limited reliability/abuse retention and optional ZDR; OpenRouter forwards input to selected or auto-routed downstream providers with provider-specific practices; Anthropic ZDR is contractual and product-scoped. Telu must disclose destination and policy at use time and must not make an unconditional local-only claim.
